# Total Clean Air

> UK-based cleanroom design, construction, and validation experts with 30+ years of experience delivering ISO 14644 and GMP-compliant controlled environments.

Total Clean Air is a UKAS ISO 17025 accredited provider specializing in bespoke cleanroom solutions ranging from portable and mobile systems to large-scale modular installations. The company offers comprehensive services including design, construction, commissioning, validation, maintenance, and decontamination for pharmaceutical, biotech, and life sciences industries.

## Key Topics

- ISO 14644 Compliance
- GMP-Certified Cleanrooms
- UKAS Accreditation
- Modular Cleanroom Solutions
- HEPA Filtration
- Rapid Deployment
- Cleanroom Commissioning & Validation
- EU GMP Annex 1
- FDA Standards
- Bespoke Design & Construction
- Cleanroom Consultancy
- Particle Counting & Testing
- Decontamination Solutions
- Preventative Maintenance
- Regulatory Compliance

## Cleanroom Products

- [Pro Series Cleanrooms | Series 1, 2 & 3](https://totalcleanair.com/pro-series): Overview of Pro Series cleanrooms (Series 1-3) with ISO 14644 compliance and modular solutions.
- [Series 1 | Portable Cleanroom](https://totalcleanair.com/cleanroom/series-1): Portable Series 1 cleanroom for field deployment with GMP and ISO 14644 compliance.
- [Series 2 | Mobile Modular Cleanroom](https://totalcleanair.com/cleanroom/series-2): Mobile modular Series 2 cleanroom offering relocatable controlled environments with ISO compliance.
- [Series 3 | Multi-Module Flagship Cleanroom](https://totalcleanair.com/cleanroom/series-3): Flagship Series 3 multi-module cleanroom for large-scale pharma and biotech manufacturing.
- [Core Series Cleanrooms | Airelab, Flexilab, Modulab & GMPlab](https://totalcleanair.com/core-series): Core Series product overview: Airelab inflatable, Flexilab modular, Modulab aluminium and GMPlab.
- [Airelab | Inflatable Cleanroom | Rapid Deployment](https://totalcleanair.com/cleanroom/airelab): Airelab inflatable cleanroom deployable in under one hour with ISO 5-9 and HEPA filtration.
- [Flexilab | Mobile Modular Cleanroom on Wheels](https://totalcleanair.com/cleanroom/flexilab): Flexilab mobile modular cleanroom on wheels with ISO compliance and rapid deployment capability.
- [Modulab | Aluminium Modular Cleanroom System](https://totalcleanair.com/cleanroom/modulab): Modulab aluminium cleanroom system offering ISO 5-9 compliance and 10 standard customisable sizes.
- [GMPlab | GMP-Compliant Modular Cleanroom](https://totalcleanair.com/cleanroom/gmplab): GMPlab GMP-compliant modular cleanroom for pharma, biotech and life sciences manufacturing.
- [Cleanrooms | Browse All Models](https://totalcleanair.com/cleanroom): Cleanroom product catalog browsing all models from Series 1-3 and Core Series with ISO certification.

## Testing, Commissioning & Validation

- [Cleanroom Commissioning & Validation | ISO 14644](https://totalcleanair.com/services/commissioning-validation): UKAS ISO 17025 accredited cleanroom commissioning to ISO 14644, EU GMP Annex 1 and FDA standards.
- [Cleanroom Testing & Validation | UKAS Accredited](https://totalcleanair.com/services/testing-validation): UKAS ISO 17025 accredited testing and validation including HEPA integrity and particle counting.

## Support & Maintenance Services

- [Cleanroom Maintenance & Servicing | PPM Plans](https://totalcleanair.com/services/maintenance-servicing): UKAS-accredited cleanroom maintenance, preventative servicing, filter replacement and 24/7 support.
- [Cleanroom Decontamination Solutions | VHP & Biocide](https://totalcleanair.com/services/cleanroom-decontamination-solutions): Advanced cleanroom decontamination using SteraMist iHP technology for sterilisation and remediation.
